summary: The agent-system project has a well-architected foundation with all 8 agents implemented, a solid provider abstraction layer, comprehensive routing, state management, security, and observability. However, there are significant gaps in actual tool integration (browser, Playwright), LLM response parsing/validation robustness, error handling completeness, and test coverage. The system is at an advanced prototype stage but needs critical fixes before production readiness.

issues: Multiple asyncio.run() calls in shutdown sequences could cause issues
No proper signal handling for graceful shutdown
CLI commands re-initialize system for each command - inefficient
Missing validation for required environment variables before initialization
recommendations: Use single event loop for CLI session
Implement lazy initialization or singleton pattern
Add pre-flight checks in doctor command

issues: No schema validation for loaded YAML configs
Missing environment variable interpolation in configs
Cache never invalidated except via explicit reload()
No configuration hot-reload support
recommendations: Add Pydantic models for config validation
Add file watcher for hot reload

issues: Exports many internal classes - consider reducing public API surface
Version hardcoded - should read from pyproject.toml
LLM planning prompt is very long - may exceed context limits
Fallback plan logic is simplistic keyword matching
No validation of LLM-generated plan structure
Conflict resolution creates new orchestrator task recursively
Agent delegation uses hardcoded AGENT_MAP - not configurable
JSON parsing in _parse_agent_response is fragile
No handling of partial/streaming LLM responses
recommendations: Add plan schema validation with Pydantic
Add structured output enforcement for all delegations
Implement proper conflict resolution without recursion

issues: _search_web() returns empty list - browser tool not integrated
All research methods just call LLM with prompts - no actual web search
No citation extraction or verification
No rate limiting for web searches
No deduplication of sources
Returns mock data instead of real research
recommendations: Integrate BrowserAgent for actual web search

issues: _apply_changes() is a stub - does not actually write files
No integration with filesystem tools for reading/writing code
No syntax validation of generated code
No test execution after implementation
No linting/type-checking integration
Diff generation is manual - not automated
Context preparation does not include git diff/history
recommendations: Add code validation pipeline (syntax, lint, types)
Auto-generate diffs from before/after file states
Add incremental context building for large repos

issues: Security review depends on external security_findings in context - not self-contained
No automated test execution to verify fixes
Architecture review limited to file sampling
No integration with security scanner results
recommendations: Auto-run security scan if findings not in context
Add test result fetching and analysis

issues: Relies on external tools (semgrep, gitleaks, trivy) being installed
No fallback if tools not available
Tool timeouts are hardcoded
No incremental scanning support
Results parsing assumes specific JSON formats
recommendations: Add tool installation verification in doctor
Implement graceful degradation when tools missing
Add incremental scan support for large repos

issues: _run_tests() uses pytest_run tool but does not handle test file creation
Test output parsing is basic regex - fragile
No support for other test frameworks (jest, cargo test, etc.)
No coverage analysis integration
Failure analysis does not actually reproduce bugs
recommendations: Integrate test file creation with coder agent
Use pytest JSON output (--json-report) for reliable parsing

issues: Uses shell commands directly - fragile, no GitHub API integration
No authentication handling for gh CLI
PR creation does not verify branch exists remotely
No support for GitHub Actions/workflows
No issue/PR querying via API
recommendations: Use GitHub SDK (PyGithub) for API operations

issues: All methods are stubs returning simulated data
No Playwright integration at all
No browser lifecycle management
No session/cookie handling
No JavaScript execution support
No screenshot capture
No rate limiting or robots.txt compliance
recommendations: Implement page navigation with wait strategies
Add data extraction with CSS/XPath selectors
Implement form interaction and JS execution
Add rate limiting and robots.txt checker

issues: Rate limiting uses simple sliding window - could be more precise
Token estimation is very rough (chars/4)
No request/response logging for debugging
Provider factory cache never expires
recommendations: Add cache TTL for provider instances

issues: Error handling could include more provider-specific error codes
No model capability detection (auto-discover what model supports)
Identical to NVIDIA provider - code duplication
OpenRouter-specific features not utilized (model routing, fallbacks)
recommendations: Refactor common OpenAI-compatible logic to base class

issues: Same code duplication as OpenRouter
Z.ai specific features not utilized
Uses native SDK instead of HTTP - different patterns
Structured output not fully supported via SDK
Token counting uses SDK usage_metadata
No async iterator cleanup on errors
recommendations: Align patterns with HTTP providers where possible

issues: Routing logic is complex but not well tested for edge cases
Health check creates new provider instances - inefficient
Fallback chain does not consider cost optimization
No routing metrics/analytics
Complexity routing uses string matching - fragile
_get_provider() has complex fallback logic that may not find correct provider
JSON repair in _attempt_json_repair() is basic regex
Structured output instruction adds many tokens to prompt
No handling of partial LLM responses
Tool execution does not propagate tool_call metadata to result
recommendations: Simplify provider lookup with direct config mapping
Use response_format for structured output when available
Add streaming support for partial responses
Track tool calls in agent results

issues: File reading limited to 100KB - may miss important large files
Keyword-based file relevance is simplistic
No semantic code search (embeddings)
Cache never invalidated on file changes
Git operations use subprocess - fragile
recommendations: Integrate code embeddings for semantic search
Add file watcher for cache invalidation

issues: No task prioritization in parallel execution
Sequential execution stops on first failure - no continue-on-error option
Workflow step conditions use raw Python expressions - security risk
No checkpointing for long-running workflows
Conflict resolution creates new task - could loop
recommendations: Add task priority queue for parallel execution
Add continue_on_error flag for sequential workflows
Use safe expression evaluator for conditions

issues: Argument validation is basic - only checks required fields
No JSON schema validation (using jsonschema library)
Terminal command uses shell=True - security risk
No tool execution sandboxing
Permission check is coarse-grained
validate_agent_result() creates new instances - loses original type info
repair_agent_result() is basic - does not handle nested validation
Confidence validation clamps but does not warn
No schema versioning for forward compatibility
recommendations: Add validation warnings for clamped values

issues: TaskType enum duplicates router.TaskType
WorkflowStep condition is raw string - security risk
No task dependency graph validation
recommendations: Use safe expression language for conditions

issues: ApprovalRequest action_type is free-form string
Checkpoint state_snapshot is untyped Dict
No workflow versioning/migration support
Permission hierarchy is hardcoded - not configurable
Action sets are static - cannot extend without code changes
No audit logging for permission checks
Pattern matching is regex-based - can be bypassed
ALWAYS_BLOCKED list is small
No allowlist mode (only denylist)
Sanitization removes dangerous parts but may leave valid command broken
recommendations: Add allowlist mode for high-security environments
Improve sanitization to preserve valid commands

issues: Tool availability checked per-scan - should cache
No support for custom semgrep rules
Trivy scan does not filter by severity
No incremental scanning
Results parsing assumes specific tool output formats
No connection pooling configuration
Cleanup deletes data without archiving
No database migration support
SQLite may not handle high concurrency well
recommendations: Implement soft-delete/archive instead of hard delete
Document SQLite limitations and PostgreSQL migration path

issues: JSON columns lose type safety
No composite indexes for common query patterns
Enum columns use SQLEnum - may have migration issues
recommendations: Add more composite indexes based on query analysis
Use native enums or check constraints

issues: See runtime.tool_manager.py assessment above
Structlog configured per-logger - should be global

JSON logs not optimized for log aggregation systems
No correlation IDs for request tracing
recommendations: Add standard fields for log aggregation (trace_id, span_id)

critical_issues.title: BrowserAgent completely unimplemented - all methods return mock data
critical_issues.description: The BrowserAgent has no Playwright integration. All navigation, extraction, interaction, and screenshot methods return simulated data. This breaks the researcher agent (which depends on web search) and makes the browser agent unusable.
critical_issues.impact: Research agent cannot perform actual web research. Browser automation completely non-functional.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Implement full Playwright integration with browser lifecycle management, page navigation, data extraction, form interaction, JS execution, screenshot capture, and rate limiting.

critical_issues.title: Researcher agent has no actual web search capability
critical_issues.description: _search_web() returns empty list. All research methods just send prompts to LLM without any actual information retrieval.
critical_issues.impact: Research agent cannot fulfill its core purpose of finding verifiable information with citations.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Integrate BrowserAgent for web search, add search engine API integration (SerpAPI, Brave Search), implement citation extraction and verification.

critical_issues.title: Coder agent cannot actually write files - _apply_changes() is a stub
critical_issues.description: The _apply_changes() method only returns a summary count. No filesystem integration for reading/writing code. No code validation pipeline.
critical_issues.impact: Coder agent cannot implement features, fix bugs, or create tests. Core coding functionality non-existent.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Integrate with fs_read/fs_write/fs_glob tools. Add syntax validation, linting, type checking. Auto-generate diffs. Run tests after changes.

critical_issues.title: Tester agent test execution and analysis is incomplete
critical_issues.description: Test output parsing uses fragile regex. No multi-framework support. No coverage analysis. Failure analysis does not reproduce bugs.
critical_issues.impact: Cannot reliably run tests or analyze failures. Testing workflow broken.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Use pytest --json-report for reliable parsing. Add multi-framework runners. Integrate coverage.py. Add bug reproduction sandbox.

critical_issues.title: JSON parsing and repair for LLM responses is fragile
critical_issues.description: _attempt_json_repair() uses basic regex. Structured output instruction adds many tokens. No handling of partial/streaming responses.
critical_issues.impact: Agent executions frequently fail due to JSON parsing errors. Wasted API calls and tokens.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Use json-repair library. Use response_format parameter for structured output. Add streaming response handling.

critical_issues.title: Terminal tool uses shell=True - command injection risk
critical_issues.description: terminal_run tool uses subprocess with shell=True. Command guard helps but shell=True bypasses argument separation.
critical_issues.impact: Potential command injection if command guard is bypassed or has gaps.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Replace shell=True with shlex.split() and proper argument passing. Keep command guard as defense in depth.

critical_issues.title: Log files never rotated - will grow indefinitely
critical_issues.description: FileHandler created without rotation. Long-running systems will fill disk.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Use RotatingFileHandler or TimedRotatingFileHandler with maxBytes/backupCount.

critical_issues.title: Multiple asyncio.run() calls in CLI commands cause event loop issues
critical_issues.description: Each CLI command calls asyncio.run() for initialize, then again for shutdown. Nested event loops not supported.
critical_issues.impact: Runtime errors in some Python versions. Resource leaks.
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Use single event loop per CLI invocation. Create async main() and run once.

items: Add code validation pipeline (syntax, lint, types)
